recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast close-up portrait of a man wearing a backwards baseball cap and dark sunglasses, set against a bright, desaturated background. The composition features heavy, distressed sans-serif typography layered over the subject's chest, creating a rugged, contemporary aesthetic.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's dark accessories (hat, glasses) contrast against the blown-out, bright background.
The textured, distressed font mirrors the stubble and ruggedness of the subject.
Wide tracking in the secondary text balances the dense, heavy weight of the primary text.
coreInvariants: Backwards baseball cap with visible snapback closure.
Distressed, weathered texture applied to the largest text elements.
High-key, desaturated background with a slight vignette or grain.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered, captured from the chest up, slightly angled to the side but looking toward the camera.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark sunglasses and the heavy, dark typography at the bottom serve as the primary anchors.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the sunglasses, move down the face to the white t-shirt, and finally rest on the large, textured text at the base.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant bright negative space in the upper corners and background to allow the subject and text to pop.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Off-white and light grey (background and t-shirt) provide a neutral canvas.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep charcoal and black (hat, sunglasses, text) provide strong graphic definition.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Natural skin tones and light brown hair provide the only warmth in the palette.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the dark foreground elements and light background.
paletteRestrictions: Stick to monochromatic tones with natural skin accents

letterConstructionRules: Primary text uses a heavy, blocky condensed structure with square terminals.
Secondary text uses a medium-weight geometric sans-serif with extreme letter spacing.
Distressed 'stamp' or 'grunge' texture applied to the primary text fill.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between heavy, condensed, textured type and light, spaced, clean type.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and condensed structure for the primary display text.
Clean geometric forms work well for the wide-tracked subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast portrait of a man with light stubble, wearing a black backwards baseball cap, black sunglasses, and a plain white t-shirt. The background should be a bright, overexposed outdoor scene (like a beach or field) with a desaturated, slightly grainy film look.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large, condensed, extra-bold sans-serif title at the bottom. Use a charcoal color with a heavy white distressed/grit texture. Above it, place a subtitle in a clean, bold sans-serif with very wide letter spacing.

verificationChecks: Is the primary text heavily distressed?
Is the subtitle tracking wide enough to span the width of the primary text?
Is the background sufficiently bright and desaturated?
Does the subject look directly toward the camera through the sunglasses?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the grit texture on the text
mustRedesign: Any specific artist names or album titles
Brand logos on the sunglasses or hat
Specific facial features of the original subject
postGenerationChecks: Text is legible despite the distress texture.
The white t-shirt doesn't disappear into the white background.
The snapback closure on the hat is clearly visible.
The overall image feels like a cohesive music industry product.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-key, desaturated male portrait with heavy, distressed condensed typography and wide-tracked secondary text to create a modern country or rock aesthetic.
